topics.label: Introduction to cancer hallmarks and lecture overview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the learning outcomes, historical framework, and overarching concepts of cancer hallmarks before examining specific molecular mechanisms.

topics.label: Growth signal autonomy and insensitivity to growth inhibitors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how mutations in receptor tyrosine kinases, Wnt, and downstream signaling cascades drive sustained cellular proliferation and bypass inhibitory cues.

topics.label: Blockade of normal cellular differentiation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how differentiation arrests keep cells in proliferative, immature states in both hematopoietic malignancies and intestinal carcinomas.

topics.label: Evasion of apoptosis via mitochondrial pathway dysregulation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details how alterations in p53 and the balance between pro- and anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family proteins prevent programmed cell death.

topics.label: Telomere biology, replicative immortality, and cellular senescence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the mechanisms cells use to bypass the Hayflick limit through telomerase upregulation and senescence evasion, concluding the review of growth-control hallmarks.

topics.label: Metabolic reprogramming and oncometabolite signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the Warburg effect, metabolic rewiring across different tissues, and the epigenetic consequences of Krebs cycle enzyme mutations.

topics.label: Tumor angiogenesis and vascular supply
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the angiogenic switch, the regulatory balance between pro- and anti-angiogenic factors, and the reliance of tumors on new vasculature for growth.

topics.label: Cellular dissemination, systemic barriers, and genetics of metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyze the multi-step invasion-metastasis cascade, the seed-and-soil model of colonization, and the clonal genomic features associated with metastatic disease.

topics.label: Lecture summary and closing remarks
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer wraps up the session by reviewing key takeaway concepts, referencing advanced reading, and providing housekeeping information for upcoming practicals.
